//! Transaction-local RLS — `SET LOCAL` inside a transaction (or `set_config(..., true)`) is scoped
//! to the transaction and reset on release, so nothing leaks across pooled checkouts. There is NO
//! bare raw-pool hatch: every acquisition routes through the tenant-scoped `scoped_conn` accessor.
impl PgStore {
    /// Scope the session TRANSACTION-LOCALLY (`SET LOCAL` is reset at transaction end).
    async fn scoped_conn(&self, tenant: &str) -> Result<Transaction, PgError> {
        let mut tx = self.begin().await?;
        sqlx::query("SET LOCAL myelin.tenant_id = $1")
            .bind(tenant)
            .execute(&mut tx)
            .await?;
        // The transaction-local `set_config(..., true)` form is equivalent and also admitted.
        sqlx::query("SELECT set_config('myelin.tenant_id', $1, true)")
            .bind(tenant)
            .execute(&mut tx)
            .await?;
        Ok(tx)
    }
}
